ops.parking: Use the Minatomirai Public Parking Lot on the first basement level of PACIFICO Yokohama. It has 1,154 standard-vehicle spaces and electric vehicle charging stations, with a height limit of 2.1 m. It is divided into Blocks A to D, and Block A is the closest to the hotel tower. Preferential rates apply only at this parking lot.
ops.waitingRooms: The medium banquet halls (Bayview, Aegean, Atlantic, Adria, Silk and Pearl) are multi-purpose rooms that can be used for business meetings, seminars, celebrations, or as waiting rooms. Adria can also be used as a waiting room for small meetings and banquets.
ops.catering: The Hotel Facility Usage Regulations state that guests should refrain from bringing food or drink into the hotel and from ordering delivery from outside.
ops.restaurants: The hotel's restaurants are Chinese Restaurant Karyu (31F), Nadaman (4F; Japanese cuisine, sushi and teppanyaki steak), French Restaurant Azur (2F), Buffet Dining Ocean Terrace (1F), Lounge & Bar Marine Blue (2F) and the music lounge Starboard (2F). For meetings and parties, the banquet halls offer plans that bundle food, drink and room fee, such as the InterContinental Party Package (choose from course meal, table service or buffet).
